summary.text: Catherine Morris is the Democratic candidate for Georgia House of Representatives District 119 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Republican Holt Persinger.

In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a working mother of two and a senior director at an international nonprofit, with a career focused on economic policy, budgeting and poverty reduction.

paragraphs.text: Catherine Morris earned a bachelor's degree from the University of California, Los Angeles in 2006 and a graduate degree from the Johns Hopkins University Nitze School of Advanced International Studies in 2011.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she began her career as an intern in the White House and earned a master's degree in international economics from Johns Hopkins.
She said she has two daughters in the Barrow County school system.
Morris advanced from the Democratic primary on May 19, 2026.

In the survey, she listed economic growth with lower taxes for working families and a strong safety net, support for parents including safer schools and affordable childcare, and expanded healthcare access beginning with Medicaid expansion as her key messages.
She named the National Democratic Redistricting Committee and The Fighting Fifty as endorsers.
